# <span id="aanchor7"></span> Ticket Autofill Editor

Users can specify default values for each field by ticket type (excluding Product Conversion, Inventory Empty, Batch Meter, and Custom Ticket types). Users can also specify autofill criteria or default options for each field on tickets on the Flow Data (Main), Accounting, Units, Custom Fields, Configuration, and Analysis tabs. Multiple autofill profiles can be created, and a default profile can be set for a specific ticket type.

If a profile is set as the default, then each ticket created of the same ticket type will automatically be populated with the values specified on the Autofill profile.

<div class="procedure">

To access the Ticket Autofill Editor and create a new autofill profile:

1.  Go to **Open** \> **Ticket Autofill Editor**.

    

<img src="data:image/png;base64," class="ScreenShot" style="width: 463;height: 521;" />

2.  Click **New**.

3.  Enter the name of the profile.

4.  Select a ticket type and group.

5.  Populate the fields with values that will be automatically filled upon ticket creation.

6.  Check **Set As Ticket Type Default** if the profile will be the default profile.

7.  Click **Save**.

</div>
